scope: Actual production native map service: source-bound discovery, detached preview and guarded import; exact canonical binary collision, existing Save As/Undo/Redo, structural source edits, actual generated 6502/PPU floor/wall movement and raw background pixels, collision edits, ambiguous graphic reuse and disclosed link-detachment fallback. Forge player/physics and authored wall are adaptations, not recovered source actors or engine equivalence. Mock DOM; no browser, independent emulator or physical hardware acceptance.

results.name: Registry discovers native resources with explicit map capability while preserving A1 container limits
Detached map stage preserves live state and recovers all 960 collision cells with explicit authored adaptation
Scene import is one guarded Undo action and Save As/reopen preserves existing scenes and native evidence
Unsupported resources and unrecognized sources stay inspectable and cannot be converted
Missing resource, wrong source identity and extra recovery options refuse without mutation
Forged, stale, duplicate and cross-resource stages cannot append a scene
Cancellation and an intervening edit during actual map staging never publish stale work
A valid native command edit removes the proven floor through structural recovery under a different filename
Detached and ordinary gameplay builds remain identical after canonical Save As and reopen
Generated 6502 preserves raw-map background pixels and the recovered floor supports the authored player
Ordinary collision-tab floor edit survives Save As/reopen and changes actual generated falling behavior
An authored canonical wall stops rebuilt movement; a metatile collision edit opens it after Save As/reopen
Source graphics reused by Empty and Solid retain distinct linked canonical collision and rebuilt support
Raw visual edits detach only the altered linked cell and expose existing tile-property fallback
Malformed persisted map evidence, collision coverage, source binding and adaptation are rejected
